name: OC Logistics TMS
description: Dispatch and compliance tools for the OC Logistics TMS backend. Provides 77 agent tools for managing loads, fleet, brokers, trailers, customers, invoices, documents, compliance, analytics, accessorials, settlements, scoring, notifications, WhatsApp, sandbox, and system meta.

backendUrl.description: OC Logistics backend base URL (overrides OC_BACKEND_URL env var)

backendToken.description: JWT bearer token for backend API (overrides OC_BACKEND_TOKEN env var)
